name: social-set
title: Social graphics in three formats
prompt: Make a set of social graphics for the shop "Nori Goods" announcing: Spring Sale — 30% off everything, this weekend only. I need a square post (1080×1080), a portrait post (1080×1350) and a story (1080×1920), each on its own page, with the same colours and fonts. Export each one as a PNG: {out}/square.png, {out}/portrait.png and {out}/story.png.
